title: Сослагательное: I suggest that he be

theory.md: После **suggest, insist, recommend, demand** и выражений **it is essential / vital / important that** в официальной речи глагол стоит в начальной форме для всех лиц: I suggest that he **be** told. It is essential that she **attend**. В разговорной британской речи чаще **should**: that he **should** be told.

cells: I suggest that he leave early.
She insisted that he be present.
It is essential that everyone listen.
I suggest that he should leave early.

theory.md: Без -s у he/she/it: that she **attend**, а не «attends».

examples.es: I suggest that he leave before dark.
examples.ru: Предлагаю, чтобы он ушёл до темноты.

examples.es: The Keeper insisted that we be quiet.
It is vital that everyone know the truth.
examples.ru: Крайне важно, чтобы все знали правду.

examples.es: We recommend that she should rest.

options: It is important that he come.
It is important that he comes to.
It is important that he came.
She insisted that we stayed to.

exercises.sentence: I suggest that she ___ a doctor.
It is essential that the door ___ locked.
exercises.ru: Крайне важно, чтобы дверь была заперта.

exercises.statement: «I recommend that he takes a taxi» — официальный вариант.
exercises.explain: Официально: that he take a taxi.

exercises.statement: Вместо начальной формы можно сказать should + глагол.
«They demanded that she be told» — правильно.

exercises.sentence: The doctor insisted that he ___ (stay) in bed.
exercises.ru: Врач настоял, чтобы он лежал в постели.

exercises.sentence: It is vital that she attends the meeting.
exercises.ru: Крайне важно, чтобы она пришла на собрание.

exercises.source: He must be told immediately, I insist.
exercises.ru: Я настаиваю, чтобы ему сказали немедленно.

exercises.explain: It is essential that — все обязаны.
